name: compliancecow-workflow
description: Workflow orchestration and automation for compliance processes in ComplianceCow.
long_description:
ComplianceCow Workflow enables powerful compliance automation through event-driven workflows. Create workflows that respond to system events, schedule automated compliance processes, and orchestrate complex multi-step operations using YAML-based definitions.

Key capabilities:
- Event-driven workflow triggers (system and custom events)
- YAML-based workflow definitions with visual mermaid diagrams
- Pre-built functions, rules, and tasks for common compliance operations
- Conditional branching and decision points
- Workflow resource data fetching
- Custom event creation for external integrations
